schemes.title: NSP Central Sector / Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education & Ministry of Social Justice, Govt. of India
schemes.summary: Merit-cum-means scholarship for Indian students pursuing post-matric or higher education with family income ceiling and minimum marks criteria.

schemes.title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India
schemes.summary: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to eligible landholding farmer families across India.

schemes.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Technical Education
schemes.ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
schemes.summary: Scholarship supporting students admitted to AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma institutions with family income below Rs. 8,00,000.

schemes.title: PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education Scholarship
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India
schemes.summary: Financial assistance covering tuition and living allowance for OBC, EBC, and DNT students in notified top-class institutions.

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Citizen Health Assurance
schemes.ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Govt. of India
schemes.summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per eligible family per year across empanelled hospitals.
